estimates.assumptions: Black pudding (morcilla) is typically around 340-350 kcal/100g; using standard value for Spanish-style blood sausage as the 150g is already given as the edible prepared weight.
Bacon lardons are ~450-460 kcal/100g when uncooked; using typical smoked pork belly lardon value for the given 100g edible weight.
Medium red peppers average ~150g each when whole and raw (edible portion after deseeding ~140-160g); 2 peppers therefore total ~300g. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g (raw state).
A single chopped plum (Roma) tomato is typically 70-90g; using 80g as average edible raw weight. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g (raw).
Standard garlic clove is ~3g; 8 cloves total 24g raw edible weight. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g (raw).
Dried white beans (e.g. cannellini or haricot) are typically 340-350 kcal/100g dry weight; the 200g measurement is the dry input weight before cooking in stock.

'6 parts' interpreted as 6 sprigs of fresh thyme; modest total edible leaf weight ~5g for the modest seasoning amount in a large recipe. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g (dried-equivalent value).
Juice from 1 lemon is typically 25-35g; using 30g average. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g.
